title: Fix-It Friday: Community Bike Repair
description:
Flat tire? Squeaky chain? Bring your bike and we will help you fix it yourself.

Stands, tools, and coffee provided. All skill levels welcome.

title: Mystic River Fall Cleanup
description:
Help clear litter from the riverbanks before winter. We will split into teams along the Mystic River Reservation.

Wear closed-toe shoes and clothes that can get muddy.

title: Porch Jazz: Last One of the Year
description: The neighborhood porch quartet plays its final set before the cold sets in. Sidewalk seating, kids and dogs welcome.

title: Tenant Rights Workshop
description:
Learn what your landlord can and cannot do: rent increases, repairs and code violations, and what to do if you receive an eviction notice.

Free. Spanish and Portuguese interpretation available.

title: Zine Swap & Print Night
description: Bring five copies of your zine, leave with five new ones. A risograph and long-arm staplers will be on hand if you want to print something on the spot.

title: Transit Justice Teach-In
description: A lunchtime session on bus network redesign, fare-free pilots, and how to testify at the next MBTA board meeting.

title: UEP Alumni Coffee Hour
description: Informal coffee with UEP alumni working in planning, policy, and advocacy. Come with questions about jobs, internships, or thesis topics.

title: Climate Resilience Open House
description: See the draft flood and heat resilience maps for the Mystic watershed and tell the planning team what they missed.

title: Seed Library Grand Opening
description: Borrow seeds in spring, return seeds from your harvest in fall. Opening day includes a seed-saving demo and free starter packets.

title: Friendsgiving Potluck
description: Bring a dish to share, or just bring yourself. Plates, cutlery, and a very large pot of soup provided.

title: Thesis Lightning Talks
description: Second-year students present their thesis work in five minutes each, followed by questions and snacks.
